title: Closed chart model of the global strict transform
statement:
Let $f\colon Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], let $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ be a finite-type quasi-coherent ideal [pqf-def-coherent], and put $X'=\operatorname{Bl}_{\mathcal I}(X)$ [def-nagata-global-blowup] and $P=Y\times_X X'$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Choose an affine cover $V_i=\operatorname{Spec}(A_i)$ of $X$, finite generating sets $G_i$ for $I_i=\Gamma(V_i,\mathcal I)$, and affine covers $W_{ij}=\operatorname{Spec}(B_{ij})$ of $f^{-1}(V_i)$. Spectra and their contravariant maps have the meaning of [def-weil-affine-spectrum].

For $c=(i,j,a)$ with $a\in G_i$, put $C_c=C_a(A_i,B_{ij},I_i)$ [def-nagata-strict-transform-basechange-chart-ring] and $C_c^{\mathrm{st}}=C_a^{\mathrm{st}}(A_i,B_{ij},I_i)$ [def-nagata-strict-transform-chart-ring]. Thus $C_c^{\mathrm{st}}$ is the quotient of $C_c$ by its $a$-power torsion. Take the $V_i$ among the affine opens over which $X'$ is glued in [def-nagata-global-blowup] (for the current blueprint datum every affine open of $X$ is one); then the local model $\mathsf B_{V_i}(\mathcal I)=\operatorname{Bl}_{I_i}(V_i)$ [def-nagata-global-blowup-local-model] is the open subscheme of $X'$ lying over $V_i$, and, $G_i$ generating $I_i$, the affine opens $\operatorname{Spec}(A_i[I_i/a])$ with $a\in G_i$ cover it [prop-nagata-affine-blowup-chart-cover]. Write $P_c=\operatorname{Spec}(C_c)$ for the corresponding ordinary base-change chart in $P$: the open subscheme $W_{ij}\times_{V_i}\operatorname{Spec}(A_i[I_i/a])$ of $P$ [lem-weil-pbc-open-preimage-fibre-product], identified with $\operatorname{Spec}(B_{ij}\otimes_{A_i}A_i[I_i/a])$ by [lem-weil-pbc-fibre-product-affine-spectra]. Write $S_c=\operatorname{Spec}(C_c^{\mathrm{st}})$, and $q_c:S_c\to P_c$ for the quotient closed immersion [lemma-nagata-strict-transform-chart-closed].

Specify a scheme-glue datum as follows. Its pieces are the $S_c$. Its overlap open in $S_c$ for a pair $c,d$ is $q_c^{-1}(P_c\cap P_d)$, where the intersection is taken as an open subscheme of $P_c$. On basic open refinements in the chosen $W_{ij}$ and in the blow-up charts, take the transition maps induced by the quotient-localization isomorphisms [lemma-nagata-strict-transform-chart-localization-data] and the localized chart comparisons [def-nagata-strict-transform-chart-comparison-localized, prop-nagata-strict-transform-chart-iso, lemma-nagata-strict-transform-chart-localization]. Concretely, for each comparison $h=\overline\sigma_a:R\xrightarrow{\sim}T$, where $R=C_a^{\mathrm{st}}(A,B,I)$ and $T=B[IB/b]$ with $b$ the image of $a$ in $B$, localization at $e\in R$ means the map $h_e:R_e\to T_{h(e)}$, $z/e^n\mapsto h(z)/h(e)^n$. For a basic-open denominator in $B$ or $A$, $e$ is its structural image. In alternative presentations $\alpha:R_e\xrightarrow{\sim}R'$ and $\beta:T_{h(e)}\xrightarrow{\sim}T'$, use $\beta\circ h_e\circ\alpha^{-1}$, with precisely the tensor-product and iterated-localization identifications specified in the cited definition. These localized equivalences identify the strict-chart presentations on the common refinements; the localization lemma identifies them with the comparisons constructed from localized data. Apply the contravariant spectrum construction to obtain the overlap maps. Glue these local maps on the overlap opens using [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-morphism-gluing]. The compatibility data needed here, including agreement on double localizations and the triple-overlap cocycle, are those of [lemma-nagata-strict-transform-chart-cocycle]. The maps are over the corresponding ambient overlaps in $P$.

Define $Y^{\mathrm{st}}_{\mathrm{chart}}$ to be the glued scheme of this datum, using the scheme-gluing construction [lem-weil-pbc-glue-schemes], and define its morphism to $P$ by gluing the maps $S_c\xrightarrow{q_c}P_c\to P$ [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-morphism-gluing]. These specified transition maps and affine quotient maps are part of the construction. No affineness of an unchosen overlap or fibre product is assumed.

blueprint_notes.label: status
blueprint_notes.text:
**Status.** Bypassed by the formalized route: the strict transform is
supplied by the API of
`WeilConjectures/Compactification/StrictTransform.lean` —
`AlgebraicGeometry.strictTransform`, its closed immersion
`AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.isClosedImmersion_pullbackLift_blowup_comap`,
and the pullback square
`AlgebraicGeometry.isPullback_strictTransformOpen` — so the
strict-transform chart rings and their cocycle are never assembled by hand.

blueprint_update.statement:
Let $f\colon Y\to X$, let $\mathcal I$ be a finite-type quasi-coherent
ideal, and put $X'=\operatorname{Bl}_{\mathcal I}(X)$. Choose an affine
cover $V_i=\operatorname{Spec}(A_i)$ of $X$, finite generating sets for
$\mathcal I|_{V_i}$, and affine covers
$W_{ij}=\operatorname{Spec}(B_{ij})$ of $f^{-1}(V_i)$. Define
$Y^{\mathrm{st}}_{\mathrm{chart}}$ by gluing the affine schemes
$\operatorname{Spec}(C_{i,j,a}^{\mathrm{st}})$ and their quotient closed
immersions into the corresponding affine pieces of $Y\times_XX'$.
On an overlap, refine to basic opens in the chosen $W_{ij}$ and in the
blow-up chart. The transition maps are the localizations of
[lemma-nagata-strict-transform-chart-localization-data]; they preserve
the quotient ideals and satisfy the double- and triple-overlap identities.
These maps, together with the affine closed immersions, are the specified
scheme-glue datum.
